scope: Descriptive charges for exactly the eight matched completed response IDs in this realized five-turn episode. Not whole-workflow totals, exhaustive hidden-response coverage, causal savings share, or a counterfactual price.
index_contract: All array indices are zero-based. input_charges[response_index] enumerates positive input-attribution item rows for responses[response_index], with input_item_index into input_items. Native metadata source_index refers to native_sources. Reconcile input/cached fields from these rows plus request_fields; reconcile output once from output_items, not by adding nested content or input/output wrappers again.
native_projection: Only pre-existing audit metadata is projected: exact item ID, kind/role/tool name/call_id, source/line and payload hash. Native bodies, including reasoning, were not inspected. File bytes were hashed without displaying or interpreting private bodies. A linked input identity is not an automatic statement about semantic content, execution count or tokenization.

uncertainty.interpretation: No frozen gap row matches these five exact turns. All eight matched response-attribution residuals are zero. This does not prove no hidden generation, retry, omitted provider event or activity outside the selected turns. No gap was zero-filled or primary bound revised.

Each exact typed interrupt also appears in the forwarded capture; recorded ordinary usage grace reaches exact usage after 21,31,27,27,48ms respectively under the unchanged1000ms maximum. limitations: Charges are provider-attribution records for repeated(thread_id,item_id), not proof of repeated execution. A native function_call_output identity may be charged repeatedly while referring to one retained tool result.

Some message identities receive a small input wrapper charge in the same response that emits their output; do not treat that as replay of a complete earlier message. Charge values are retained exactly, including varying per-item values.
Input totals include cached input. Caching is not zero raw-token input. Tools and instructions request-field attribution is kept separate from message/tool-result items.

The phase primary test did not establish the work-unit treatment effect. This episode cannot assign a causal savings percentage, establish a treatment-specific effect, or price an alternative trajectory.
Tests-only then implementation remain separate accepted ACKs under frozen coding; the earlier known-red intermediate-patch compliance observation is not excused or a new exclusion rule.
Full source endpoints are hashed; native input links rely on the admitted frozen audit's exact identity join, without parsing or copying native bodies here.
